onscreen_lines.desc: REMOVE EXISTING UNIT AND INSTALL NEW PORCH DECKING & JOISTS, STEPS, AND RAILING: RELOCATE EXISTING METAL RAMP. Completely remove the porch decking and joists. Install new treated joists, sized and spaced per code, with a double joist around the perimeter. All joists are to be installed with joist hangers at headers and ledger. Ledger plate to be lag screwed to house framing per code. Beams to be set on posts per code. Fasteners for preservative treated wood shall be of hot dipped zinc coated galvanized steel, stainless steel, silicon bronze or copper. Coating types and weights for connectors in contact with preservative treated wood shall be in accordance with the connector manufacturer's recommendations. In the absence of manufacturer's recommendations, a minimum of ASTM A 653 type G185 zinc coated galvanized steel, or equivalent, shall be used. Exceptions: 1. One half inch (12.7 mm) diameter or greater steel bolts. 2. Fasteners other than nails and timber rivets shall be permitted to be of mechanically deposited zinc coated steel with coating weights in accordance with ASTM B 695, Class 55 minimum. Install new decking using 5/4" X 6" treated decking lumber. All perimeter edges are to be rounded and sanded. Install new steps and railing as per codes. Contractor to verify measurements. All work performed under IRC Codes. Location: FRONT ENTRY **RELOCATE METAL RAMP**
